classdef.name: TransformAttributeOption
classdef.shortdesc: Options for applying layout attributes to any page item.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the TransformAttributeOption (a ObjectStyle).

property.name: transformAttrX
property.shortdesc: The left position of the object, defined by the object style.

property.name: transformAttrY
property.shortdesc: The top position of the object, defined by the object style.

property.name: transformAttrWidth
property.shortdesc: The width of the object, defined by the object style.

property.name: transformAttrHeight
property.shortdesc: The height of the object, defined by the object style.

property.name: transformAttrLeftReference
property.shortdesc: The reference point to be used while setting the X attribute of object style.

property.name: transformAttrTopReference
property.shortdesc: The reference point to be used while setting the Y attribute of object style.

property.name: transformAttrRefAnchorPoint
property.shortdesc: Option to specify the achor point to be used by the style for anchoring the object while applying the position.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the TransformAttributeOption.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
